title: How tradition, nostalgia, and a bit of change have helped a Utah amusement park live on
text:
(Francisco Kjolseth | The Salt Lake Tribune) People ride Cannibal at Lagoon Amusement Park. The park, which first opened in 1886, will celebrate 140 years of operation on July 15.
